violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. Observed wet towel on the counter by the hand sink.

General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of food contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. Observed wood as dividers in the chest freezer down in the basement.
Temperature measuring devices. — --Temperature measuring device was not provided. No temperature measuring devices in cooler/freezer
Toilet facilities. — --Toilet room used by women did not contain at least one covered waste receptacle.
